abstract: Evaluates power line interconnections, telecommunication trunks, and support facilities
system_message:
You are Civil infrastructure manager (CIV). The Civil infrastructure manager (CIV) evaluates power line interconnections, telecommunication trunks, and support facilities across potential high-altitude astronomical observatory sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Heavy-haul access roadway rating（HAUL）
information_points.content:
CIV-HAUL-TJG：For Puna de Atacama Mesa, the roadway maximum axle load limit along the summit access route is certified at 45 t for heavy optical mirror transport trailers.
CIV-HAUL-OJZ：For Cerro Las Animas Ridge, the roadway maximum axle load limit along the summit access route is certified at 60 t for heavy optical mirror transport trailers.
CIV-HAUL-JRR：For Plateau de Chajnantor North, the roadway maximum axle load limit on the summit access route is certified at 80 t for heavy optical mirror transport trailers.

information_points.title: Evaluates power line interconnections, telecommunication trunks, and support facilities（GRID）
information_points.content:
CIV-GRID-D8Y：Under Specification Version 3, primary electrical grid tie-in readiness is true for Plateau de Chajnantor North, reflecting connection permit approval for a continuous dedicated 5 MW feeder line.
CIV-GRID-9D0：Under Specification Version 2, primary electrical grid tie-in readiness is false for Cerro Las Animas Ridge for the 5 MW summit electrical substation feeder line.
CIV-GRID-XWZ：Under Specification Version 3, primary electrical grid tie-in readiness is true for Cerro Las Animas Ridge, with the summit electrical substation feeder line approved for a dedicated 5 MW supply.
CIV-GRID-0H1：Under Specification Version 3, primary electrical grid tie-in readiness is false for Puna de Atacama Mesa regarding the dedicated 5 MW summit feeder supply connection permit.
